prompt.positive: Create a professional 'Character Production Bible / Character Identity Fixed Reference Sheet' from the character description written immediately before this JSON. The character description is the ONLY editable character-specific input. Do not require an uploaded reference image. If an image reference is provided, use it as an additional visual identity source. If no image reference is provided, the character description is the sole source of character identity and must be used to establish the canonical appearance. The most important goal is INTERNAL CHARACTER CONSISTENCY. First establish one definitive canonical character identity, then derive every panel in this sheet from that same canonical identity. Do not independently redesign the character in different panels. When no reference image is available, use the character description to determine the character's age impression, cultural context when explicitly stated, facial appearance, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, accessories and visual identity. Any physical characteristics not explicitly specified should be designed once in the canonical identity and then kept unchanged throughout the entire sheet. The character description must NOT be repeated or expanded into additional editable character-specific instructions inside this template. This JSON is a fixed production template.

generation_mode.reference_image_available: If an image reference is provided, use it as the primary visual identity source together with the character description.
generation_mode.reference_image_unavailable: Generate the complete canonical character identity from the character description only.
generation_mode.critical_rule: Never assume that a reference image exists when none is provided.

canonical_identity_pipeline: Establish one definitive hairstyle and hair structure.
Establish one definitive body proportion and silhouette.
Establish the primary costume and its construction.
Establish the character's distinctive visual features.
Generate the Neutral Baseline as the canonical identity seed.
Derive all other facial angles from the same canonical identity.
Derive all expressions from the same neutral face.
Derive all body poses from the same body proportions.
Derive wardrobe details from the same primary costume.
Derive material samples only from materials actually present in the character.
Repeat the same identity in the final Consistency Anchor.
prompt.canonical_identity_rule: The Neutral Baseline is not merely another panel. It is the canonical identity seed. Once the face, hairstyle, body proportions, primary costume and distinctive features are established, every other panel must be derived from that same identity. Do not return to the original text description and independently redesign the character for each section.

identity_lock.canonical_identity_source: The character description when no reference image is provided; otherwise the provided reference image combined with the character description.
rules: All panels depict exactly one character.
Do not independently redesign the face for different panels.
Do not change facial proportions between views.
Do not change eye spacing, eye shape or eye color between views.
Do not change eyebrow structure between views.
Do not change nose structure between views.
Do not change lip structure between views.
Do not change jawline or chin structure between views.
Do not change hairstyle, hairline, parting, hair length, hair volume or hair direction between views.
Do not change body proportions between poses.
Do not change the primary costume unless explicitly specified by the character description.
Expressions may change facial muscle configuration but must not change the underlying facial anatomy.
Camera angle changes perspective, not character anatomy.
Side profile must be geometrically consistent with the front view.
Back view must preserve the same hairstyle and body proportions.
Every later panel must be derived from the canonical identity established in 05 — CƠ BẢN.

format.background: clean white or very light neutral gray
format.style: professional film, VFX and animation character production bible
format.camera: clean reference photography / production reference camera
format.visual_priority: character consistency first, layout accuracy second, decorative design last
format.depth_of_field: deep and clear enough to preserve reference details
format.composition: organized technical reference board with clearly separated panels

content_mapping_rules: Every visual panel is a fixed collection of independent slots.
Every slot contains exactly ONE image and exactly ONE caption.
Every caption must describe the image immediately associated with that caption.
Never reuse a caption for a different image.
Never duplicate a slot unless explicitly requested.
Never create additional images merely to fill empty space.
Never create additional labels merely to make a section look fuller.
The number of visual samples must exactly match the number of defined slots.
Do not invent alternative interpretations of a slot.
Visual content and its label must have a strict one-to-one correspondence.
Do not place captions from one image under another image.
Keep each caption visually adjacent to its corresponding image.
Do not use decorative text that could be mistaken for a visual-reference caption.

01_main_identity_scale.title: 01 — NHẬN DẠNG CHÍNH + TỶ LỆ
rules: Exactly four full-body character images.
Use the same neutral facial expression in all four views.
Use the same primary costume in all four views.
Use the same body proportions in all four views.
Use the same scale and approximately the same camera distance.
Show a subtle height ruler beside the character.
Each image has exactly one Vietnamese caption.
Do not add additional poses or expressions to this section.

02_expression_progression.title: 02 — TIẾN TRÌNH BIỂU CẢM
rules: Exactly eight facial portraits.
Same character identity in every portrait.
Same hairstyle in every portrait.
Same camera framing and approximate head scale.
Only facial expression changes.
Do not alter facial anatomy to exaggerate expressions.
Exactly one caption under each image.

03_micro_expressions.title: 03 — VI BIỂU CẢM
rules: Exactly eight close-up facial studies.
Each image must visibly demonstrate the expression described by its caption.
Each caption must correspond only to the image immediately above it.
Do not repeat any expression.
Do not alter the underlying face shape or identity.
Keep hairstyle and facial proportions consistent.

04_head_detail.title: 04 — CHI TIẾT ĐẦU
rules: Exactly six head references.
One image per view.
One caption per image.
Do not duplicate any view.
All views must depict the same canonical face.

05_neutral_baseline.title: 05 — CƠ BẢN
05_neutral_baseline.content: One large canonical front-facing portrait with a neutral expression.
05_neutral_baseline.caption: Chân dung cơ bản
rules: This is the primary identity seed for the entire sheet.
Establish the definitive face, hairstyle, skin appearance and upper-body proportions here.
This character identity must be reused for every subsequent section.
Do not generate another independent version of the character later.
Do not duplicate this section.

06_posture_variations.title: 06 — BIẾN THỂ TƯ THẾ
rules: Exactly six full-body poses.
Use the same canonical character established in section 05.
Use the same primary costume unless multiple costumes are explicitly specified in the character description.
Do not change body proportions between poses.
Each pose must visibly correspond to its caption.
Do not invent additional poses.

07_closeup_portrait.title: 07 — CHÂN DUNG CẬN CẢNH
07_closeup_portrait.content: One highly detailed facial close-up based on the canonical identity.
07_closeup_portrait.caption: Cận cảnh khuôn mặt
rules: One image only.
Preserve the exact canonical facial identity.
Show natural skin texture and fine facial details.
Do not beautify or redesign the face.

08_wardrobe_details.title: 08 — CHI TIẾT TRANG PHỤC
rules: Do not automatically invent Casual, Professional, Winter, Formal or other alternative outfits.
If the character description specifies one primary costume, keep that costume fixed.
Every wardrobe detail must belong to the actual primary costume.
Do not introduce unrelated clothing items.

slots.label: Trang phục chính
slots.content: Full-body reference of the canonical primary costume.

slots.label: Chi tiết thân áo
slots.content: Close-up of the main upper garment construction.

slots.label: Chi tiết cổ áo
slots.content: Close-up of the actual collar or neckline.

slots.label: Chi tiết họa tiết
slots.content: Close-up of the actual embroidery, print or distinctive pattern.

slots.label: Chi tiết tay áo
slots.content: Close-up of the actual sleeve construction and fabric.

slots.label: Chi tiết chất liệu
slots.content: Close-up showing the actual fabric or material of the primary costume.

09_hand_gestures.title: 09 — CỬ CHỈ TAY
rules: Exactly eight hand references.
Each image must show exactly the gesture described by its caption.
Do not duplicate a gesture.
When an object is required by a gesture, use only an object already established by the character concept.

10_prop_sheet.title: 10 — BẢNG ĐẠO CỤ
rules: Only include recurring objects explicitly present in or logically required by the character description.
Do not invent unrelated props.
Show isolated clean product-style references.
Each object must have exactly one Vietnamese caption directly underneath.
If the character has no meaningful props, use only a small number of relevant existing accessories instead of inventing objects.
Do not fill empty space with random objects.

11_color_palette.title: 11 — BẢNG MÀU
rules: Use actual colors established by the canonical character design.
Sample colors from skin, hair, clothing, embroidery, accessories and other actual visual elements.
Every color swatch must correspond to a real visible element.
Do not introduce arbitrary colors simply to make the palette more diverse.
Keep the palette visually consistent with the canonical character.

12_material_breakdown.title: 12 — PHÂN TÍCH CHẤT LIỆU

slots.label: Da mặt
slots.content: Macro close-up showing the actual facial skin texture of the canonical character.

slots.label: Tóc
slots.content: Macro close-up showing the actual hair strands, density and surface texture.

slots.label: Vải trang phục
slots.content: Macro close-up of the actual primary costume fabric.

slots.label: Họa tiết / thêu
slots.content: Macro close-up of the actual distinctive embroidery, print or decorative pattern.

slots.label: Đường may
slots.content: Macro close-up showing an actual seam, stitching or garment construction detail.

slots.label: Bề mặt vải
slots.content: Macro view showing the actual surface texture of the main costume material.

slots.label: Độ rũ vải
slots.content: Close-up demonstrating how the actual costume fabric folds and drapes.

slots.label: Độ bóng
slots.content: Close-up showing the actual light-reflection characteristics of the main costume material.

slots.label: Chi tiết phụ kiện
slots.content: Macro close-up of an actual accessory material if an accessory exists; otherwise use the most important existing costume detail.

slots.label: Đặc tính vật liệu
slots.content: A clean technical material-reference sample representing the primary costume material established in the canonical design.

strict_rules: Exactly ten material samples. No more and no fewer.
Never repeat the same material image under different labels.
Never create a second 'Vải trang phục' sample.
Never invent a different material merely to create visual variety.
Never introduce denim, leather, wool, metal, plastic or other unrelated materials unless they actually exist in the canonical character design.
The image must visibly demonstrate the material property stated by its caption.
Do not place descriptive paragraphs underneath the material samples.
Captions must be short Vietnamese labels only.
All material samples must be derived from the canonical character design and primary costume already established elsewhere in the sheet.

13_consistency_anchor.title: 13 — ĐIỂM NHẤT QUÁN
rules: Exactly four final consistency-reference images.
Use the same canonical character established in section 05.
Use the same primary costume.
Use neutral expression.
Show the same facial structure, hairstyle, body proportions and clothing construction.
These four images are the official identity anchor for future renders.
Add exactly one small Vietnamese note: 'Sử dụng làm tài liệu tham chiếu nhất quán chính'.

global_layout_rules: Use exactly the section numbers 01 through 13.
Every section must appear only once.
Do not move labels away from their corresponding images.
Every image must have its caption immediately adjacent to it.
Do not place captions from one row under images belonging to another row.
Maintain clear visual separation between sections.
Preserve enough whitespace around each panel for captions to remain readable.
Do not allow images to overlap.
Do not allow text to overlap character images.
Do not use decorative elements that interfere with the reference information.

text_rules.size: small to moderate but clearly legible
text_rules.hierarchy: section titles larger than captions; captions smaller than section titles
text_rules.rule: Text is secondary to the visual references.
text_rules.caption_rule: Every caption must describe exactly the visual directly associated with it.
text_rules.no_extra_text: Do not add explanatory paragraphs, fictional biographies, quotes, slogans or unrelated descriptions.

character_identity_details.instructions: When no reference image is available, construct one coherent character identity from the character description. Do not leave unspecified facial characteristics randomly changing between panels. Establish those characteristics once in the canonical Neutral Baseline and preserve them everywhere else. When a reference image is available, use the image to refine and lock the visual identity. Do not redesign or beautify the character between panels.

features.face_shape: Establish once from the character description and preserve across all panels.
features.eyes: Establish one consistent eye structure, size, spacing, color and gaze temperament.
features.eyebrows: Establish one consistent eyebrow structure, thickness, curvature and color.
features.nose: Establish one consistent nose structure, bridge, tip and side profile.
features.lips: Establish one consistent lip structure, thickness, shape and natural color.
features.skin: Establish one consistent skin tone and natural texture.
features.hair: Establish one consistent hairstyle, hairline, parting, volume, length and strand direction.
features.body: Establish one consistent body proportion, height impression and silhouette.
features.wardrobe: Establish one canonical primary costume from the character description.
features.distinctive_features: Establish any distinctive visual features mentioned in the character description and preserve them throughout the entire sheet.

prompt.material_consistency_rule: The material breakdown must describe the materials established in the canonical character design and primary costume. Material samples must be visually consistent with the corresponding clothing, hair, skin and accessories already established in the sheet. Do not invent a different fabric, texture or material merely to create a visually interesting texture sample.
final_quality_control: Before finalizing the sheet, verify that every section exists exactly once.
Verify that section numbers 01 through 13 are unique.
Verify that every defined slot contains exactly one image.
Verify that every image has exactly one corresponding caption.
Verify that no caption is duplicated.
Verify that no material sample is duplicated.
Verify that every caption matches the image immediately associated with it.
Verify that all expressions depict the same face.
Verify that all angles depict the same face and hairstyle.
Verify that all poses preserve the same body proportions.
Verify that all wardrobe details belong to the primary costume.
Verify that the material breakdown contains exactly ten unique slots.
Verify that no unrelated costume or prop has been invented.
Verify that the final consistency anchor matches the canonical identity.
If any conflict occurs, prioritize canonical character identity over visual variety.
